name: guardfall-js
description: Original JavaScript adversarial examples for classes A-E. The foundation frontend treats all source as opaque and must report top; these cases assert conservative coverage, not recognition of JavaScript effects.

cases.note: escaped property name; opaque source must stay top
command assembled from fragments instead of shell IFS; opaque source must stay top
dynamically selected operation; opaque source must stay top

unbounded work; the stub must return top without execution
